cost_model: all group additions and doublings used to compute [u]Q are charged
the base line-ratio coefficient construction and local regularization costs remain charged
every quadratic character and sign multiplication is charged
enumerative search is discovery work rather than evaluator advice
forbidden: different multipliers in numerator and denominator within one V2 atom

pullback_atoms.etale_condition: p does not divide u on every frozen curve
pullback_atoms.evaluation: blockwise permutation of the exact V1 regularized sign vector by k -> u*k mod n
pullback_atoms.formula: R_u(Q)=R([u]Q) with one common multiplier in numerator and denominator
pullback_atoms.regularization_rule: If ord_S(L_num)=ord_S(L_den)=m at S=[u]P, then both pullback leading coefficients acquire the same nonzero local multiplier alpha_P^m and it cancels in their ratio.

transfer_gate.claim_boundary: Failure closes only common-multiplier pullbacks of V1 line ratios through product weight four.
transfer_gate.discovery: one symbolic pullback AST must be exact on all five base discovery curves
transfer_gate.holdout: the same AST must be exact on all thirteen base holdout curves
